Filtering out the dying creature when collecting watchers...

Actually, I'm noticing something important about how the trigger gets created. The code generates a `DeathWatch` trigger for every permanent on the battlefield without checking if the description is empty first — unlike the `EnterWatch` case which explicitly guards against that. This means all permanents get queued up with a death trigger, even if they don't actually have an `AnyCreatureDies` ability defined. The actual filtering must happen later when the trigger resolves.

When the trigger fires, it checks that the watcher is still on the battlefield, then calls `on_any_creature_dies` on the card's behavior. But this is being called on every permanent, not just those with the trigger defined. I need to look at what the default implementation of `on_any_creature_dies` does to understand if it's filtering out the permanents that shouldn't respond.
